raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: When asked to use a mapping/review service and verify accessibility, WebSurfer instead relied on a generic Bing results list and did not confirm wheelchair accessibility or systematically compare distances. It treated the listed venues as accessible without verification and later only measured the distance to 12 Steps Down—ultimately selecting a basement bar that is not wheelchair accessible as the “closest accessible” option. This failure to verify accessibility and to compare multiple candidates led directly to the wrong final answer.
